== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ruler]] techniques are a form of ability that allows an individual to manipulate compatible aura within their environment. Unlike some other abilities, these techniques are not restricted by birth and can be learned by anyone. They function by commanding the fundamental principles of the world to obey the user, effectively allowing them to command the surroundings. These techniques can be used to create various effects, such as manipulating fire, crafting illusions that affect the mind and eyes, or even controlling blood to cause physical distress like seizures. In practice, [[Ruler]] techniques are often categorized alongside other methods such as [[Striker]], [[Forger]], and [[Enforcer techniques]]. While they are capable of immense power—including the ability to create massive constructs like stone cages or jagged blades from the air—they require significant time and concentration to build. Because of this, they are often slower to deploy than simpler techniques. The effectiveness and speed of a [[Ruler technique]] can be influenced by the availability of [[vital aura]], and their power often increases the longer they are maintained. Some advanced users can combine these abilities with other arts to achieve devastating results, such as manipulating spatial dimensions or commanding the very elements of nature.}}
